high_level_description: The image is a news article headline from the "Technology" section, featuring a photograph of two men shaking hands at an event. The headline reads: "Taiwan chip titan TSMC opens joint lab with University of Tokyo." Below the headline, there is a subheading that states: "Chipmaker 'definitely' committed to Japan despite huge US investment, says executive." The photograph shows Teruo Fujii, President of the University of Tokyo (on the left), and Y.J. Mii, Executive Vice President and Co-Chief Operating Officer of TSMC (on the right).
